kind: Predeclared diagnostic reference (not a recipe trial, not counted against the single-factor trial limit)
question: Does the legacy native route (BF16 direct AdamW, update_policy=parameter) at native lr 5e-6 effectively not train, explaining why the native recipe looks stable while fp32_master collapses?
configuration: Identical to trial 1 (native LIBERO-10 profile, 8 envs on 8 GPUs, 4 updates per 128-decision window, fused torch AdamW, lr 5e-6, value_lr 1e-4, clip 1.0, seed 17, aligned_200) except rl.optimizer.update_policy=parameter (no FP32 masters; AdamW updates BF16 parameters directly).

prediction.quality: Every completed aligned_200 evaluation at update >= 80 stays within the frozen 90.5% +/- 2 points (0.885-0.925; 177-185 of 200), with mean episode_steps <= 339.10.
prediction.update_size: Per-window actor parameter_update_l2 (recorded in windows.jsonl) is near zero, or at least 10x smaller than trial 1's fp32_master value over the same windows (trial 1 actor parameter_update_l2 ~0.39 per window at window 4).

falsification: The mechanism is falsified if the legacy run degrades below 0.885 at any evaluation >= 80, or if its median actor parameter_update_l2 over windows 1-20 is more than 1/10 of trial 1's median over the same windows.
consequence_if_supported: The native recipe baseline effectively does not train; the paired comparison must be fp32_master fused vs fp32_master 8-bit at a stable lr, with the legacy route reported separately as a no-op reference.
stop_rule: Run to completion of the update-160 evaluation unless quality falls below 0.885 (prediction already falsified; cancel then).

result.verdict: PREDICTION HOLDS: quality within 0.885-0.925 at updates 80 and 160 (steps <= 339.1), and legacy actor update size is 0.072x trial 1's (< 1/10). Qualification: BF16 direct updates are small but not zero (about half of fp32_master at lr 1e-6, i.e. an effective lr near 5e-7); the legacy route is a near-no-op reference, not an exact no-op. No improvement observed (0.900 -> 0.895).
result.status: CANCELLED at the predeclared stop rule after the update-160 evaluation
